core_obligations: Construct the universal first order thickenings attached to the composite and to the two formally unramified morphisms.
Use formal smoothness of the composite to show the connecting map vanishes, upgrading the conormal sequence to a short exact sequence.

proof_roadmap.step: Set up the universal first order thickenings for the pair and the composite.
Compare them through the formally smooth hypothesis.
Show the connecting map vanishes and conclude short exactness.

difficulty_reason: The lemma sharpens the conormal sequence of a pair of formally unramified morphisms: when the composite is additionally formally smooth, the sequence is short exact rather than merely right exact. The proof constructs the relevant universal first order thickenings, compares the two thickenings through the formally smooth hypothesis, and shows that the connecting map vanishes, which upgrades right exactness to exactness in the middle. The comparison of the two universal thickenings and the identification of the vanishing condition is the substantive step. Retained author proof at lines 5036-5080 with the surrounding argument.

compared.difference: Hypothesis difference: the schemes side assumes the commutative diagram is of schemes; this side assumes algebraic spaces over S. Conclusion difference: none, both conclude short exactness of the conormal sequence under formal smoothness of the composite.
